header.description: Send WhatsApp messages and manage instances through the ZapZap API

resource.description: What you want to work with

sendMedia.description: Send an image, video, audio, document or sticker by URL

sendInteractive.description: Send a poll, buttons or an options list

react.description: React with an emoji to an existing message

create.description: Create a new WhatsApp instance (charged from your balance)

getStatus.description: Return the WhatsApp connection status of the instance

getQrCode.description: Return the QR code to link WhatsApp to the instance

list.description: List every instance in the account

instanceId.description: WhatsApp instance ID (the UUID returned when you create or list instances)

number.description: Recipient number in international format: country code + area code + number, digits only. For groups, use the group ID (@g.us).

file.description: Public file URL. Per-URL limit: image, video and audio around 190 MB, document around 500 MB.

interactiveText.description: Main text (the poll question, or the body of the buttons or list)

id.description: Message ID in OWNER:MSGID format. Do not use the Baileys format concatenated with the JID.

emoji.description: Reaction emoji. Leave empty to remove the reaction.

name.description: Instance name. Letters, numbers, _ and - only.
